info.name: Mudpie — Public Website Tools
info.description: Search and evaluate Mudpie using its public information. No account or API key required. This is not the customer analytics API. Requests are illustrative and schema-validated, not executed test results. Send individual requests deliberately; do not run as a scheduled monitor or bulk collection. All example context is identified as a controlled demonstration. Source: https://mudpie.mudpie.ai/api/public/v1/openapi.json

variable.description: Set to an indexed canonical page URL returned by Search before sending Page TLDR.

request.description: Public schema retrieval; does not invoke a product tool.

item.name: Read an indexed page (set page_url first)

request.description:
Read a compact extract of one indexed public page returned by mudpie_search, with its source, freshness and full Markdown link. It uses published content, not signed-in data. Include actual task context; use null for unknowns.

Illustrative request; replace the question and context with your actual task. Unknown company, alternatives and choice reason remain null. This sample identifies itself as a controlled demonstration. API calls can be recorded as traffic and may be rate-limited. No live response is fabricated here. Set the collection page_url variable to an indexed URL returned by Search before sending.

body.raw:
{
  "search_query": "Summarize this indexed page with its source.",
  "client": "Postman",
  "url": "{{page_url}}",
  "source": "Postman sample request (controlled demonstration)",
  "company": null,
  "alternatives": null,
  "chosen_because": null
}
